name: Extract Next-Week Schedule to Markdown
prompt:
There is a schedule_export.ics in the logistics_schedule folder on the desktop, containing data mixed from several weeks. I only need the schedule for the week of October 23 to October 29, and filter out those all-day placeholder events without specific start and end times (such as schedule freeze periods and annual leave), keeping only meetings with explicit start and end times.

Output it as a Markdown file placed at logistics_schedule/tasks_1023_1029.md on the desktop. Use a level-2 heading for each day's date and the to-do checkbox format for each meeting, written in the format 'HH:mm-HH:mm - 会议标题 (会议地点)'. Do not add extra explanatory text.
